SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as store_count
FROM tmp_lfl_store_list_2025

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  SUM(r.net_sales) as net_sales
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON r.business_date = d.calendar_date
INNER JOIN tmp_lfl_store_list_2025 lfl ON r.store_id = lfl.store_id
WHERE d.fiscal_period = 4
  AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2026/27')
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_year

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  ROUND(
    ((
      SELECT SUM(r.net_sales) 
      FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r
      INNER JOIN dim_date d ON r.business_date = d.calendar_date
      WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 4
        AND r.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM tmp_lfl_store_list_2025)
    ) - (
      SELECT SUM(r.net_sales)
      FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r
      INNER JOIN dim_date d ON r.business_date = d.calendar_date
      WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 4
        AND r.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM tmp_lfl_store_list_2025)
    )) / (
      SELECT SUM(r.net_sales)
      FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r
      INNER JOIN dim_date d ON r.business_date = d.calendar_date
      WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 4
        AND r.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM tmp_lfl_store_list_2025)
    ) * 100, 2
  ) as lfl_growth_pct

SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT closure_id) as closure_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT store_id) as closed_store_count
FROM ref_store_closure
WHERE closure_start_date <= '2026-08-30' AND closure_end_date >= '2025-07-28'
  AND store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM tmp_lfl_store_list_2025)

SELECT 
  rc.closure_id,
  rc.store_id,
  s.store_name,
  rc.closure_type,
  rc.closure_start_date,
  rc.closure_end_date
FROM ref_store_closure rc
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT store_id, store_name FROM dim_store WHERE is_current = TRUE) s 
  ON rc.store_id = s.store_id
WHERE rc.closure_start_date <= '2026-08-30' AND rc.closure_end_date >= '2025-07-28'
  AND rc.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM tmp_lfl_store_list_2025)

calls.statement:
WITH lfl_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_period,
    SUM(r.net_sales) as net_sales
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON r.business_date = d.calendar_date
  INNER JOIN tmp_lfl_store_list_2025 lfl ON r.store_id = lfl.store_id
  WHERE d.fiscal_period = 4
    AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2026/27')
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(
    ((SELECT net_sales FROM lfl_sales WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27') - 
     (SELECT net_sales FROM lfl_sales WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26')) /
    (SELECT net_sales FROM lfl_sales WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26') * 100, 2
  ) as lfl_growth_pct
